description: This file defines a command class for synchronizing database permissions in the Superset project, including both synchronous and asynchronous execution via Celery tasks. It handles permission updates for catalogs, schemas, datasets, and charts, with error handling and validation.

classes.name: SyncPermissionsCommand
classes.description: A command class to synchronize database permissions, supporting both sync and async modes, handling catalogs, schemas, datasets, and permissions renaming.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates database connection, user session, and connectivity before permission sync.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes permission synchronization either asynchronously via Celery or synchronously.

methods.name: sync_database_permissions
methods.description: Performs the actual permission synchronization for catalogs, schemas, datasets, and charts.

methods.name: _get_catalog_names
methods.description: Retrieves catalog names based on database capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: _get_schema_names
methods.description: Retrieves schema names for a given catalog.

methods.name: _refresh_schemas
methods.description: Adds permissions for schemas that do not yet have permissions.

methods.name: _rename_database_in_permissions
methods.description: Renames permissions related to the database, catalogs, schemas, datasets, and charts.
